concept.title: Reading the chart
concept.shortdesc: The outline on the left lists the tasks, numbered as an outline (1, 1.1, 1.2, 2). A task with sub-tasks has an arrow that folds them away. The figure at the end of each row is the task's progress.

conbody.p: On the timeline, each task is a bar from its start to its due date:

ul.li: The bar fills from the left as the task progresses.
A green bar is a task in Done. A red bar is late: it is past its due date and not done.
A task with sub-tasks is drawn as a thinner, darker bar that spans all of them.
An arrow runs from a task to each task that waits for it. A dashed red arrow means the waiting task starts before the other one ends; the outline marks that task with a warning sign.
A task with no dates yet shows + Schedule at today.

conbody.p: The row of Milestones above the tasks holds a diamond for each milestone, with its name and progress. The thin band leading up to a diamond, from the milestone before it, fills as that milestone's criteria are met. The red vertical line is today.

Days, Weeks, Months and Quarters change the scale. The page opens at the scale that shows the whole plan. The figures above the chart count the plan: how far it is complete, its tasks, those done, late and not yet scheduled, and the milestones met.
